'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC female Noble Gladiator participating in the Hunt, seen talking with two male Gladiators, '''Este''' and '''Sforza'''. They can be found in the [[Hunter's Den]] speaking about [[Avidius]]. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:;'''Este''' Always rambling on about glory, and then he aligns himself with that scorpion ''[[Falco]]''?!
:;'''Este''' No Gladiator worth their honor would crawl that low.
:;'''Sforza''' Say what you want, but Avidius has what it takes to lead!
:;'''Baglionia''' Enough. Let's not tear each other apart until we know the whole picture.
:'''Baglionia:''' Ephor Augusta is certainly capable. But cries for Avidius to be the next Hero of Heroes grow louder by the day.
:'''Baglionia:''' Makes you wonder whose banner we should rally behind. A difficult choice indeed... 
:'''Sforza:''' I respect the Ephor and hold no prejudice toward her background, but let's be honest. A Hero of Heroes is defined by innate talent, not by a crown of victory from the Great Agon! 
:'''Sforza:''' Avidius has braved four successful expeditions into Manes Deep. If that doesn't prove he's fit to be ruler, what does?
:'''Este:''' Still, he's backed by Falco. That venomous scorpion alone should be enough to make you question his judgment!
----
;;After {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}
:;'''Sforza''' Avidius is a hero, no doubt. Always has been, and he still is.
:;'''Baglionia''' I've always known Ephor Augusta would turn the tide sooner or later...
:;'''Este''' Ha, listen to you. Since when did you start playing Priestess?
:'''Baglionia:''' That's not the way to put it, Lord Este. My loyalty to the Ephor has never wavered. Her deeds shine as gloriously as the eternal blazing sun. A mere figure like Avidius can never be compared to her.
:'''Sforza:''' The Ephor's deeds are indeed admirable. But I must insist that Avidius, too, is a true Gladiator and a hero deserving of the same glory!
:'''Este:''' I agree with you, Sforza. I have respect for Avidius as well.
:'''Este:''' As for you, Baglionia, spare us your theatrics.
:'''Este:''' A profit-chasing opportunist has no loyalty to offer. You'd call yourself faithful no matter who comes out on top.
----
;After {{Quest|By Moon's Fated Light}}
:'''Sforza:''' After the catastrophe, Augusta has truly come into her own.
:'''Baglionia:''' Still no word on Avidius… and that Priestess…
:'''Este:''' She seems cunning… but who exactly is she? Doesn't ring any bells.
----
;After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}
:;'''Sforza''' Still no word on Avidius?
:;'''Baglionia''' Ephor Augusta hasn't given a straight answer. Who knows where he's gone?
:;'''Este'''Ha, maybe she's the one pulling the strings!
:'''Baglionia:''' That's not the way to put it, Lord Este. Ephor Augusta's radiance is beyond question. On what grounds could she ever deal with Avidius?
:'''Sforza:''' The Ephor's virtues are beyond reproach. Still, it troubles me that we've heard nothing of Avidius so far.
:'''Este:''' I heard a report that he was last seen in Ragunna, but since then, there has been no word.
:'''Baglionia:''' You see? The Ephor has no part in this. Our concern should be finding Avidius's whereabouts.
:'''Este:''' May the winds of Septimont not shift because of this.
{{Dialogue End}}
